Introduction

U-KISS (an acronym for Ubiquitous Korean International Idol Super Star) is a South Korean boy group formed by NH Media in 2008. The group officially debuted in South Korea on August 28th, 2008, with the live performance of their debut song, "Not Young", on Mnet. U-KISS is currently composed of six members: Alexander, Soohyun, Kiseop, Eli, AJ, and Hoon.

In June 2023, former members Eli, Alexander, and AJ teamed up with the group once again to release the album "PLAY LIST", in celebration of U-KISS' 15th debut anniversary.

As of December 31, 2024, U-Kiss is on an indefinite hiatus, with members currently working on individual activities.
